verdict.rationale: BILL's v3 API claims access to the "full breadth" of the platform, including S&E. It covers budgets, users, virtual cards, transactions and reimbursements, and adds real-time S&E webhooks, audit trail and export endpoints. However, nothing documents UI-to-API parity, and several UI features (custom approval policies, the AI Invoice Coding Agent, purchase-order matching) are not shown as API-accessible for S&E. missing for 10: an explicit parity statement or endpoint-by-feature mapping, API coverage of S&E approval policies and AI coding features, a public OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.
